prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. One strong central scene occupies about two thirds. All supplied teaching text MUST be rendered INSIDE the image. Preserve Swedish å, ä, ö and every letter exactly. Generous margins, phone-legible text. No watermark, logo, app chrome, contact sheet, or unsupplied paragraphs. Sound/spelling associations are memory aids, never pronunciation or etymological claims.
Header text verbatim: "personlig". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "personal".
Scene: A person closing a small handwritten diary and holding it close, a private desk with a personal photo and a pen, no readable diary entries.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "personlig resembles personal.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Det här är min personliga dagbok.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
